```plato

    // Three-way comparison derived from the total order: negative when a < b,
    // zero when equal, positive when a > b. Declared as a member on IComparable,
    // but derivable from IOrderable alone, so it lives here on the base interface.
    Compare(a: IOrderable, b: IOrderable): Integer
        => a == b ? 0 : (a <= b ? -1 : 1);
```
